title: Finite affine Cech vanishing for coefficient-sized intrinsic comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u and A any commutative ring in max(v,u+1), with additive sheafification on the coefficient-sized etale and pro-etale site models of [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-data]. Let I be injective in constant-A module sheaves on the etale model. Let V_a -> U be a finite covering in the precoverage associated to the pro-etale model topology, such that AsSmall.down(U) and every AsSmall.down(V_a) have proAffineEtale structure morphism to X [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. For every choice S of the iterated fibre products and index maps of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] and every q >= 0, the (q+1)-st Cech cohomology of the underlying abelian presheaf of the intrinsic comparison pullback of I is zero. There is no enough-injectives assumption and no derived functor in this statement. The finite family may be empty; X need not be affine, qcqs, or nonempty; A need not be finite.

source.place: Tag 099U, lemma-affine-vanishing, two inverse-limit reductions of finite Cech cohomology; Cohomology on Sites Tag 03FC, module-injective Cech calculation.

proof.text: Construct compatible affine etale covering presentations of the whole prescribed nerve, with scheme limit cones on every intersection. This simultaneously implements the two geometric finite-cover reductions; it allows non-affine ambient X and repeated factors.

Pass from the injective constant-ring module sheaf I to its injective module presheaf. Enlarge Fin m to ULift Fin m to put indices and homs in the same coefficient universe. Apply the injective-presheaf cocycle lifting theorem and restrict the primitive back to Fin m. Thus every positive cocycle of each normalized etale stage has a primitive.

Prove constant-scalar restriction fully faithful and essentially surjective using module sheafification, and identify its canonical constant-section ring map with the comparison ring map. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the natural intrinsic/fixed-scalar comparison isomorphism. On every nerve presentation, coefficient continuity gives a colimit of comparison sections. The fully faithful left Kan extension unit and the presentation sheafification isomorphisms replace its stages by the original etale sheaf sections.

Prove directly that finite cocycles descend through these filtered section colimits. Choose representatives of all finitely many components at a common stage. Naturality of every index map identifies the differentials. Each component of the differential is eventually zero; a filtered wide span gives one later stage where all vanish. Take a stage primitive, then compare it to the original cochains. The primitive equation proves ExactAt and hence zero positive homology. Transport homology along the intrinsic/fixed-scalar natural isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099U; explicit finite cocycle representatives and eventual zero replace an abstract filtered-exactness invocation. All statements and coefficient universes are unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientComparison_affineCech_vanishing (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    [HasSheafify (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max v (u + 1)}]
    [HasSheafify (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max v (u + 1)}]
    (I : ConstantCompletion.Mod (ConstantCompletion.constant
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A)) [Injective I]
    (U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (m : ℕ) (V : Fin m → Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (f : ∀ a, V a ⟶ U)
    (hU : proAffineEtale (AsSmall.down.obj U).hom)
    (hV : ∀ a, proAffineEtale (AsSmall.down.obj (V a)).hom)
    (hc : Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).toPrecoverage U)
    (S : SiteCechComplex V f) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero ((S.cohomologyFunctor (q + 1)).obj
      ((constructibleComparisonPullback.{u, v} X A).obj I).val.presheaf)
